A '''security chief''' worked at the [[Junction (purification facility)|Junction]] purification facility on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] in [[3643 BBY]]. He helped a [[The Barsen'thor|Jedi Consular]] who was looking for the insane [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Cin Tykan]] to track down the Master.
